# GemSphere Technologies Private Limited

> https://gemsphere.ai

GemSphere Technologies Private Limited is a global AI-powered enterprise software engineering and custom digital platform provider. We design, build, and deploy unified, composable digital ecosystems spanning commerce, logistics, finance, business operations, and custom AI development for organizations across 170+ countries.

## Entity Information
- **Legal Entity**: GemSphere Technologies Private Limited
- **Brand**: GemSphere.ai
- **Headquarters**: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
- **Global Availability**: 170+ countries
- **Supported Locales**: English (en / x-default), German (de), French (fr), Spanish (es), Japanese (ja), Arabic (ar - RTL), Brazilian Portuguese (pt-br)
- **Mobile Distribution**: Android client available via Google Play Store (`com.gemsphere.pos`)
- **Syndication & Feeds**: RSS 2.0 Feed available at https://gemsphere.ai/feed.xml
- **Asset Links Verification**: Google Digital Asset Links at https://gemsphere.ai/.well-known/assetlinks.json

## Core Products & Composable Modules (50+ Architectural Blueprints)

- [Commerce & Smart Retail POS](https://gemsphere.ai/en/products/commerce/) - Omnichannel retail checkout, high-throughput POS, real-time inventory synchronization, catalog management, and automated tax compliance.
- [Supply Chain & Logistics](https://gemsphere.ai/en/products/supply-chain/) - Strategic sourcing, Warehouse Management (WMS), Transportation Management (TMS), and automated fleet telemetry.
- [Finance, Billing & Books](https://gemsphere.ai/en/products/finance/) - Enterprise cloud accounting, multi-entity general ledger, recurring subscription billing, and GST/VAT compliance engines.
- [Operations & CRM](https://gemsphere.ai/en/products/operations/) - Single-tenant enterprise CRM, automated sales pipelines, workforce management, and enterprise resource planning (ERP).
- [Hospitality & Restaurant Management](https://gemsphere.ai/en/products/hospitality/) - Cloud Hotel PMS, table reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), and contactless QR ordering.
- [Enterprise AI & Autonomous Agents](https://gemsphere.ai/en/ai-solutions/) - Private Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, domain-specific LLM fine-tuning, and autonomous business workflow agents.
- [EduSphere Campus ERP](https://gemsphere.ai/en/products/edusphere/) - Student Information Systems (SIS), automated fee collection, and university administrative orchestration.

## Enterprise Solutions Architecture

- [Enterprise Digital Transformation](https://gemsphere.ai/en/solutions/enterprise-digital-transformation/) - Phased legacy monolith modernization using the Strangler Fig pattern, event-driven microservices, and zero-downtime cutover.
- [Omnichannel Retail Infrastructure](https://gemsphere.ai/en/solutions/omnichannel-retail-infrastructure/) - Sub-second barcode scan-to-receipt checkout throughput, offline-first SQLite POS sync, and zero transaction commissions.
- [Private Cloud Migration](https://gemsphere.ai/en/solutions/private-cloud-migration/) - 100% dedicated single-tenant VPC deployments, eliminating multi-tenant noisy-neighbor risks and ensuring strict GDPR/BDSG compliance.
- [Intelligent Business Automation](https://gemsphere.ai/en/solutions/intelligent-business-automation/) - Multi-step autonomous AI agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and private enterprise RAG pipelines with zero public data retention.

## Professional Engineering Services

- [Custom Enterprise Software Development](https://gemsphere.ai/en/services/custom-software-development/) - High-throughput backend architectures built with strict Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
- [Microservices & Cloud Migration](https://gemsphere.ai/en/services/microservices-development/) - Decoupling legacy monolithic codebases into resilient, independently scalable microservices.
- [Enterprise AI & LLM Engineering](https://gemsphere.ai/en/services/ai-consulting/) - Secure, single-tenant enterprise generative AI workflows and model fine-tuning.
- [Application Modernization & DevOps](https://gemsphere.ai/en/services/application-modernization/) - Full-stack cloud engineering, continuous integration (CI/CD), and automated telemetry.

## Key Architectural & Compliance Specifications
- **Data Isolation**: Single-tenant database isolation models ensuring zero customer data leakage.
- **Architectural Paradigm**: Strict Domain-Driven Design (DDD) with decoupled bounded contexts (Billing, Inventory, Identity, AI).
- **Compliance Readiness**: Engineered to support SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, ISO/IEC 27001, and EU GDPR compliance frameworks.
- **Mobile Client**: Native Android application distributed exclusively via Google Play Store (Package: `com.gemsphere.pos`).
